groupings.title: viaSocket: app integrations, automations, AI, AI memory, login, MCP servers, plugs
groupings.description: For the product's users: connect any of 2,300+ apps, run their actions, react to their events, automations per user, an AI assistant on any model, AI memory, and login with teams and organisations. For the signed-in developer: setup in one click, their own automations, an MCP server for the product, and the product as an app on viaSocket.
